articles.title: Designing AI-Supported Multimodal Russian Language Learning: A Conceptual Framework for Learner Autonomy, Critical AI Literacy, and Intercultural Competence

author.affiliation: Faculty of Languages and Foreign Literature, University of Tehran, Iran

articles.abstract: This conceptual article develops a framework for AI-supported multimodal Russian language learning that connects technological affordances with learner development. The framework is organized around AI-supported personalization, multimodal task design, learner autonomy, critical AI literacy, and intercultural communicative competence.
